  "reason": "The assistant incorrectly describes the Italian referendum system, stating that referendums can be requested by the people without signatures for electoral laws and some constitutional provisions, and that a 50%+1 majority of valid votes is required. This contradicts the provided reference, which specifies that constitutional amendments, accession to collective security organisations or supranational communities, and urgent federal acts without constitutional basis valid over one year are subject to mandatory referendum without signature collection, requiring a majority of voters and cantons.",
  "evidence": "In Italia, i referendum abrogativi e confermativi possono essere richiesti dal popolo senza che sia necessario raccogliere firme, a condizione che siano soddisfatte determinate soglie di partecipazione. In particolare, per essere validi, i referendum devono ottenere almeno il 50% più uno dei voti validi."
